infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TRACE records your position on track during an active session to time your laps and sectors. Location is only used while a session is running and never in the background.

NSLocationTemporaryUsageDescriptionDicti.TrackSession: TRACE needs precise location during this track session to time your laps and sectors accurately; approximate location isn't accurate enough for lap timing.

infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: TRACE can optionally connect to a WiFi OBD-II adapter on your local network to show advisory vehicle telemetry (RPM, speed, throttle, coolant temperature). This is read-only and never used for lap timing.
